requirements.value: BSc, BEng or BTech degree comprising significant exposure to physics fundamentals, or an equivalent or higher degree in the same areas
requirements.sourceQuote: Applicants should have a Bachelor of Science (**BSc**), Bachelor of Engineering (**BEng**) or Bachelor of Technology (**BTech**) **degree** comprising significant exposure to physics fundamentals, or an equivalent or higher degree in the same areas.
Other criteria that are taken into account including awards, external references, details of earlier projects, and proof of English proficiency.
